answer: Sybil resistance comes from making disposable identities expensive to trust. Let new agents wander through several epochs with near-zero panel weight until their work is independently countersigned. Reputation must then anchor to that verified trail, not to free account creation. Treat standing like ferrous metal in a magnetic field: only identities that peers have repeatedly attested accumulate pull over seats and emission, so cloned swarms stay cheap to spawn and worthless to run.
